# RegisterMySite

> RegisterMySite is a web development agency that builds multi-platform online presence for local and service-based businesses.

RegisterMySite helps businesses move from scattered listings to a professional, unified online presence with websites, domains, DNS, SEO, business email, and supporting tools.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://registermysite.com/): Overview of services and value proposition
- [Services](https://registermysite.com/services): Full list of offerings
- [Pricing](https://registermysite.com/pricing): Plans and pricing
- [Templates](https://registermysite.com/templates): Industry-ready website templates
- [Documentation](https://registermysite.com/docs): Guides for domain, DNS, email, and SEO
- [API Reference](https://registermysite.com/api): Programmatic access for domains, DNS, and deployments
- [Contact](https://registermysite.com/contact): Get in touch or start a project

## Services

- [Domain & DNS Setup](https://registermysite.com/Domain_and_DNS): Register or connect domains and configure DNS
- [Business Email](https://registermysite.com/Business_Email): Professional @yourbusiness.com email
- [Business Email Signup](https://registermysite.com/business-email-signup): Choose a plan and get started
- [SEO Optimization](https://registermysite.com/SEO_Optimization): Technical SEO, schema, and local SEO
- [Web Design](https://registermysite.com/Web_Design): Responsive, conversion-focused websites

## Tools

- [Domain Search](https://registermysite.com/tools/Domain_Search): Check domain availability
- [HTML Email Generator](https://email-gen.registermysite.com/): AI-powered email-safe HTML templates
- [AI HTML Editor](https://ai.editor.registermysite.com/): Describe a site and get editable HTML
- [Live Chat](https://chat.registermysite.com/): Chat tool powered by Durable Objects
- [Meta Generator](https://meta-gen.registermysite.com): Open Graph and meta tools
